parts.gloss: I do not (first-person singular negative suffix)

literal: Desire's fierce flood swimming, shore I do not see; even at midnight, I indeed am awake.
translation: Swimming in the fierce flood of desire, I cannot see the shore; even in the dead of night, I am left all alone, awake.
modern: காமம் என்னும் கொடிய வெள்ளத்தில் நீந்தியும் அதன் கரையை நான் காணவில்லை; நள்ளிரவிலும் நான் ஒருவளே விழித்திருக்கிறேன்.
explanation: The heroine describes her overwhelming suffering during separation. She compares her intense passion to a fierce, rushing flood (கடும்புனல்) in which she is drowning. Though she struggles and swims (நீந்தி) constantly, she cannot find any shore (கரை காணேன்) or relief. To intensify her grief, even during the dead of night (யாமத்தும்) when the rest of the world is asleep, she alone remains awake (யானே உளேன்) with her painful thoughts.
